description: This file defines the CopyActivityModel class in the OrangeHRM Time plugin API. It models a data structure used for copying project activities, including properties for project activities from a source project and their duplicated counterparts. The class provides a toArray method for serialization.

classes.name: CopyActivityModel
classes.description: A model representing project activities for copying and their duplication status, with serialization capabilities for API responses.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model's data into an array suitable for API response, indicating whether each activity is unique.
